name: CIRCUIT — Zero-shot Global
protocol: CIRCUIT v1 fixed 510 questions, plain zero-shot with diagrams, no netlist, global <0.001 absolute-error accuracy; one-shot and template-pass metrics are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of 510 questions whose parsed answer differs from ground truth by less than 0.001.
explanation.zh: 分数是 510 道题中，解析答案与标准答案绝对误差小于 0.001 的比例。

summary.en: CIRCUIT evaluates numerical reasoning over basic, analog, power, and RF circuit problems.
summary.zh: CIRCUIT 评估模型解决基础、模拟、电力和射频电路数值问题的能力。

task_format.en: The model inspects a circuit problem and diagram, then returns a numerical answer to six decimal places.
task_format.zh: 模型阅读电路题和电路图，再给出保留六位小数的数值答案。
